## What happened

Incident notice INC-0274 concerns a Vendor API outage that began on 2025-11-18 and continued until 2025-11-19. During this period, the affected vendor API was unavailable, and normal processing could not proceed as expected. The incident was recorded for operational follow-up and service monitoring.

## Cause

The outage was caused by a Supplier cloud region failure. This failure disrupted access to the vendor API and prevented dependent services from completing their normal activities. The cause has been recorded against incident INC-0274 for review and tracking.

## Effect

The immediate effect was that Pilot scores delayed. Work relying on the vendor API could not be completed within the expected timeframe while the outage was active. The service was monitored through the incident period, which ended on 2025-11-19. Questions about this notice should be directed to the service desk, quoting INC-0274.
